decisions.decision: A dependency-free, non-production reference provider host executes every provider fixture against the actual OpenAPI method/path/request/response schemas. It is contract evidence only and is prohibited from production composition.

Connected integration and real-backend acceptance fixtures use generated OpenAPI Lead list/detail/create operations. Retired generic Lead update/qualification authority is tested only as fail-closed and is never treated as production success.
Lead and Product list/detail reads use explicit closed OpenAPI projections. Frontend-local normalization and composed counts/facets remain non-authoritative and are not promoted to generic endpoints.

Shipping Booking and Return list/detail reads use explicit closed OpenAPI projections with workspace-scoped authorization, whitelisted pagination/filter/sort semantics and server-owned resourceVersion.

The reference provider host does not prove production persistence, transaction isolation, provider transport, token validation or cross-workspace enforcement. All external provider packs must still execute against a provisioned backend and two isolated workspaces.
evidence: No production/non-production backend provider URL, credentials or workspace fixtures were supplied.
